summary: This is a preliminary prospectus supplement filed by Realty Income Corp. under Rule 424(b)(5) for a proposed public offering of senior unsecured notes due 2032. The filing discloses aggregate principal amount, interest payment terms, optional redemption provisions, and listing plans on the NYSE. There is no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The offering is a routine debt capital markets transaction for a REIT, not a special situation.
